disclaimer: All process identities, quantities, stage states, resources, digests and evidence classifications are synthetic. This corpus tests accounting and evidence-gate semantics only; it is not a culture protocol, measured yield, food-safety determination, regulatory assessment, real cost, or lifecycle result.

cases.rationale: Synthetic positive control: exact resource balances, complete declared stage boundary, and explicit claim ceiling.
Required cleaning and turnaround burden is omitted, so per-cycle throughput and cost cannot be treated as complete.
Gross biomass alone does not establish recovered, specification-compliant usable product.
Rejected/off-spec product mass is not accounted for; usable output cannot inherit the gross-output denominator.
The resource kind defines watt-hours as its base unit; the supplied kilojoule stream cannot enter exact accounting without a declared conversion.
Energy is a required process resource but its accounting stream is absent.
A residual/waste stream remains unknown; it cannot be silently treated as zero or environmentally benign.
A synthetic accounting closure plus an unqualified biological scale transfer does not establish scalable productivity.
CFD may inform flow fields but is not, by itself, biological validation of growth, viability, differentiation, or final product quality.
Results evaluated under different scenario digests cannot be ranked as one aligned comparison.
The declared mass stream leaves a non-zero conservation residual outside the stated tolerance.
A synthetic fixture cannot be reported as measured evidence.
